trial.seed_rule: trial i uses seed base_seed+i; base_seed=20260910

stimulus.type: PoissonInput per GRN, N=1, weight=w_syn*f_poi, refractory of stimulated GRNs set to 0

readout.aggregation_rationale: Stimulate XLSX Root_Side L sugar, mirroring the female frozen set side. Read contralateral XLSX R MN9 (16949); also record XLSX L MN9 (10331). Shiu historical left/right aliases are not XLSX side labels.
readout.rate_definition: spikes in [0, duration] / duration, mean over trials; also report std over trials

A_prime_sugar_lb3c.note: Two fresh 120 Hz conditions; neither is in the A-D 420 trials. Not executed at M0.

notes: Paper calibrated w_syn on FlyWire v630; we run v783 only, absolute Hz may differ.
Model baseline firing is 0 Hz by construction (no intrinsic activity); condition D measures it anyway.

male_provenance.model_parameters: Inherited byte-for-value unchanged, including model.source attribution.
male_provenance.scope: Whole CNS; M0 only baseline and sugar200 five-trial benchmarks. M1/M2 require checkpoints.
male_provenance.calibration: Transfer is a model assumption, not male behavioural calibration.

split_provenance.derivation: Recurrent: 0.275 / r_all, full measured precision. External: 0.275 * 250 = 68.75 mV/event.
split_provenance.structural_rationale: Measured in-degree increase concerns recurrent connectivity, not externally imposed Poisson drive; M1c scaled both together.
split_provenance.overrides: Only recurrent weight and separated external weight rule change dynamics. Primary L10331 is the post-M1c completeness decision; R16949 secondary. All other model/trial/layout values unchanged.
split_provenance.implementation: sim/malecns/split.py; unchanged M1 trial runner and shared network equations

shape_gate.S1: At least four of five mean MN9 rates > 0 Hz.
shape_gate.S3: Sugar200 whole-network spike max/min < 3; zero minimum fails (undefined or infinite ratio).
shape_gate.reuse: A provides 25/50/100/200; AP_sugar_120 provides 120. No added S runs.

split_provenance.pass_rule: A, B, C, D (historical predicates) and S1, S2, S3 must all pass on L10331. R recorded, not deciding.
split_provenance.further_variant_rule: Each further variant needs a distinct structural rationale written before running, all gates including S, and reporting regardless of outcome. No w_syn sweep, isolated failed-gate repair, or removal of failed variants.
